reviews.message: I have used Sparks eSIM for travel in EU and Central America over the last two years. Great product! reviews.name: eSim for Norway
reviews.message: Unfortunately, my newly purchased Sparks eSim failed to install on my iPhone 13. I addressed Sparks technical support over an e-mail and got an immediate reply. They guided me how to retrieve and send them information (ICCID) regarding the various SIMs and eSIMs installed on my phone, and, once verified that the Sparks eSim is indeed not installed, they’ve sent me a QR Code for a new eSim, which has been successfully installed. The responses from Sparks technical support to my emails were almost instantaneously and the problem was quickly resolved. The initial failure to install is still a mystery, but the prompt response and the corrective action were quick, professional and generous. Thank you!
reviews.title: Great technical support
